cycle_rule: Latest six-hour cycle at least six hours before issue; require actual object LastModified <= issue separately
valid_time_rule: floor(issue to hour)+horizon; never replace a forecast with an analysis

limits: Single-sample compressed byte estimate; date/field layouts can differ

Object LastModified is not verified first-publication latency
0.25 degree GFS does not resolve mountain-scale local winds
